objective: Ot va sifatni ajratib, o‘zimni va tanish kishilarni tasvirlayman.

reading.title: My Teacher
reading.text: I am Ali. I am a student. My teacher is my mother. She is kind. My father is a new student. He is happy. My sister is a student. We are students. Our teacher is happy. My father is a student. My mother is our teacher!

questions.prompt: Who is Ali's teacher? (Alining o‘qituvchisi kim? Inglizcha qisqa javob yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My teacher is my mother” — Ali o‘qituvchisi uning onasi ekanini aytadi.

questions.prompt: Who is a new student? (Yangi o‘quvchi kim? Inglizcha qisqa javob yozing.)
answers: his father is a new student
Ali's father is a new student
questions.explanation: “My father is a new student” — yangi o‘quvchi Alining otasi.

questions.prompt: How is Ali's father? (Alining otasi qanday holatda? Inglizcha qisqa javob yozing.)
questions.explanation: Ota haqidagi gapdan keyin “He is happy” deyilgan — u xursand.

listening.title: My Neighbour
listening.text:
Mina: I am a new student.
Lola: I am Lola. I am your teacher.
Mina: My neighbour is Lola. She is kind.
Lola: I am your neighbour!
Mina: You are my neighbour. You are my teacher!
Lola: We are friends.
Mina: I am happy!

questions.prompt: Who is a new student? (Yangi o‘quvchi kim? Inglizcha qisqa javob yozing.)
questions.explanation: Mina “I am a new student” deydi — yangi o‘quvchi Mina.

questions.prompt: How is Lola? (Lola qanday inson? Inglizcha qisqa javob yozing.)
questions.explanation: Mina “My neighbour is Lola. She is kind” deydi — Lola mehribon.

questions.prompt: Who is Mina's neighbour? (Minaning qo‘shnisi kim? Inglizcha qisqa javob yozing.)
questions.explanation: Mina “My neighbour is Lola” deydi. Lola “I am your teacher” degani uchun her teacher javobi ham to‘g‘ri.

speaking.prompt: 20–30 soniyada Ali yoki Mina kabi o‘zingizni va bir tanish kishini tanishtiring. Student, teacher, friend yoki oila a’zosi nomidan foydalaning; kind, happy, new sifatlaridan ikkitasini ayting.
success: O‘zi va bir tanish kishi haqida kamida uchta gap aytiladi.
Kamida ikkita ot va kind/happy/new dan ikkita sifat ishlatiladi.
I am / He is / She is / My … is tayanchlari bilan ma’no tushunarli beriladi.

writing.prompt: 20–40 so‘zda o‘zingiz va yaqin kishilaringiz haqida yozing. Student, teacher, friend yoki oila a’zosi otlarini hamda kind, happy, new sifatlaridan ikkitasini ishlating.
writing.model: I am Madina. I am a new student. My teacher is kind. My brother is my friend. He is happy. I am happy. We are friends.
success: 20–40 so‘z yozilgan.
Kamida uchta ot va o‘rgatilgan ikkita sifat bor.
I am / My … is / He is / She is / We are qoliplarida ega va tavsif mos.

teacherNote: Oldindan faqat uch sifat: kind — mehribon, happy — xursand, new — yangi. Qolgan mazmunli so‘zlar lug‘atning 1–25 bosh so‘zidan; ism tarjima qilinmaydi. Scaffold: I am / My … is / He is / She is / You are / We are va a tayyor tanishtiruv qoliplari; students/friends dagi -s faqat tanish otning ko‘plik ko‘rinishi. Readingda otni doira, sifatni chiziq bilan belgilang; otaning o‘quvchi rolini mimika bilan kulgili ko‘rsating. Listeningni matnsiz ikki marta o‘qing: avval kim gapirayotganini, keyin Lola ham qo‘shni, ham o‘qituvchi ekanini aniqlating. Inglizcha savollarni yonidagi o‘zbekcha ma’no bilan o‘qib bering; who/how va egalik yozuvi mustaqil grammatika talabi emas. Sekin o‘quvchiga odam rasmlari va be qoliplarini bering; ilg‘orga yangi lug‘at qo‘shmasdan bir kishini ikki rol bilan tanishtirishni topshiring.

objective: Harakat fe’li, olmosh va ravishni qisqa matnda taniyman.

reading.title: The Slow Robot
reading.text: I am a robot. My name is Pip. I walk slowly. I read quickly. I work here. Sara is my friend. She reads slowly. She is careful. We work together. I often smile. Sara smiles too. A robot and a student are a good team.

questions.prompt: What is the robot's name? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My name is Pip” — robotning ismi Pip.

questions.prompt: How does Pip walk? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I walk slowly” — Pip sekin yuradi.

questions.prompt: Who reads slowly? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Sara is my friend. She reads slowly” — she Sara o‘rnida.

listening.title: A Quiet Radio
listening.text:
Host: I am Ben. I speak quietly. This is our radio club.
Zara: I am Zara. I listen carefully. I write here.
Host: We work together. My dog is here too.
Zara: He sleeps often.
Host: Yes. He is our quiet friend. We talk; he sleeps!

questions.prompt: Who speaks quietly? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: Ben “I speak quietly” deydi.

questions.prompt: How does Zara listen? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: Zara “I listen carefully” deydi.

questions.prompt: Which animal is at the club? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My dog is here too” — klubda it bor.

speaking.prompt: Pip va Sara haqida 30 soniya gapiring: ismni bir marta ayting, keyin he yoki she bilan almashtiring. Ikki harakatning qanday bajarilishini ayting.
success: Ikki harakat fe’li ishlatiladi.
He yoki she mos kishiga ishora qiladi.
Slowly yoki quickly bilan bitta to‘g‘ri ma’no beriladi.

writing.prompt: 20–40 so‘zda o‘zingiz va xayoliy robotingizning ishlashini tasvirlang.
writing.model: I am Aziz. I read slowly. My robot is Dot. It reads quickly. We work together. I write carefully. Dot smiles often. We are happy.
success: 20–40 so‘z bor.
Ikki harakat va ikki ravish keltirilgan.
Bir ot keyingi gapda mos olmosh bilan almashtirilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: robot — robot, quietly — past ovozda, carefully — diqqat bilan. Readingda fe’llarni harakat bilan ko‘rsating; dialogni avval umumiy mazmun, keyin ravishlar uchun o‘qing. Sekin o‘quvchiga fe’l–ravish juftini bering; ilg‘or he olmoshining kimligini dalillaydi. Scaffold: Present Simple shakllari bu yerda so‘z turkumiga namuna, -s qoidasini hali baholamang; savol qoliplarini o‘zbekcha tushuntiring.

objective: Joy predloglari, and/but bog‘lovchilari va ega olmoshlari bilan sodda ma’no bog‘layman.

reading.title: Lunch in the Classroom
reading.text: We are in the classroom. I am at my desk. Jamila is at the door. She is happy, but I am hungry. My lunch is in my bag. It is a banana and a sandwich. You are my friend. We are ready for lunch.

questions.prompt: Where is Jamila? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Jamila is at the door” — Jamila eshik yonida.

questions.prompt: Who is hungry: the narrator or Jamila? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “She is happy, but I am hungry” — och odam hikoyachi.

questions.prompt: What fruit is in the bag? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “It is a banana and a sandwich” — meva banan.

listening.title: The Garden Team
listening.text:
Aziza: We are in the garden. You are at the gate, Bob.
Bob: Yes. They are in the house.
Aziza: They are Mum and Dad. He is tired, but she is happy.
Bob: My hat is in the tree!
Aziza: It is red and very high.

questions.prompt: Where are Aziza and Bob? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “We are in the garden” ularning joyini aytadi.

questions.prompt: Who is tired? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “They are Mum and Dad. He is tired” — he Dadga ishora.

questions.prompt: Where is Bob's hat? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: Bob “My hat is in the tree” deydi.

speaking.prompt: Sinfdagi tushlik manzarasini sherigingizga 30 soniyada tushuntiring: ikki joy va ikki odamni ayting.
success: In va at bilan ikki joy aytiladi.
I, she yoki we dan ikkitasi ishlatiladi.
And yoki but bilan ikki fikr ulanadi.

writing.prompt: 20–40 so‘zda bog‘dagi yangi manzarani yozing. Shlyapa qayerdaligini ham ayting.
writing.model: We are in the garden. My sister is at the gate. She is happy, but I am tired. My hat is in my bag. It is blue and small.
success: 20–40 so‘z yozilgan.
Ikki joy birikmasi bor.
And va but ma’noga mos ishlatilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: gate — darvoza, hungry — och, high — baland. Readingda joylarni rasmga joylang; listeningni ikki ovozda ikki bor o‘qing. Sekin o‘quvchiga in/at rasmli tayanch bering; ilg‘or olmoshlarning egalarini izohlasin. Scaffold: my va for lunch tayyor birikmalar; a/the artikllari hozircha namuna sifatida beriladi.

objective: Sodda gapda ega, fe’l, to‘ldiruvchi va tavsiflovchi qismni ajrataman.

reading.title: The Book Doctor
reading.text: Nodir repairs books. He is a librarian. I bring a book. The book is old. Nodir opens it carefully. He uses glue. I watch Nodir. He is patient. My book is ready. Nodir is a book doctor. His desk is a small hospital!

questions.prompt: What does Nodir repair? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Nodir repairs books” — to‘ldiruvchi books.

questions.prompt: What does he use? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “He uses glue” — yelim ishlatadi.

questions.prompt: What is Nodir's job? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “He is a librarian” — uning kasbi kutubxonachi.

listening.title: A Portrait for Grandma
listening.text:
Laylo: I draw Grandma. She is kind. I use a pencil.
Tim: I draw her cat. It is fat.
Laylo: Grandma likes pictures. She is an artist.
Tim: I use green paint.
Laylo: The cat is grey, Tim!
Tim: My picture is funny. Grandma smiles.

questions.prompt: Who does Laylo draw? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I draw Grandma” — Laylo buvisini chizadi.

questions.prompt: What colour paint does Tim use? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: Tim “I use green paint” deydi.

questions.prompt: What is Grandma's job? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “She is an artist” — buvi rassom.

speaking.prompt: Kitob ta’mirlash yoki rasm chizish haqida 30 soniya gapiring. Ega–fe’l–to‘ldiruvchini uch barmoq bilan ko‘rsating.
success: Ikki gapda ega, fe’l va to‘ldiruvchi aniq.
Bitta be + kasb yoki sifat gapi bor.
Nodir yoki buvi haqidagi bir fakt to‘g‘ri aytiladi.

writing.prompt: 20–40 so‘zda Nodirga o‘xshash foydali ish qiladigan odamni tasvirlang.
writing.model: My aunt repairs bags. She is patient. I bring a red bag. She uses a needle. I watch her. My bag is ready. My aunt is happy.
success: 20–40 so‘z bor.
Ikki harakat gapi to‘ldiruvchi bilan yozilgan.
Kamida bitta be + sifat gapi bor.

teacherNote: Oldindan: glue — yelim, librarian — kutubxonachi, paint — bo‘yoq. Readingda ega/fe’l/to‘ldiruvchini uch rangga ajrating; listeningda avval odam, keyin buyumlarni yozdiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga rangli gap kartalari; ilg‘orga is a librarian bilan repairs books tuzilishini solishtirish. Scaffold: uchinchi shaxs -s va likes faqat gap qismlarini ko‘rsatadi, zamon qoidasi talab qilinmaydi.

objective: Ega–fe’l tartibini saqlayman, be va harakat fe’lini ajrataman, bosh harf va tinish belgisini qo‘llayman.

reading.title: A Dog with a Job
reading.text: I am Kamol. I work at a shop. My dog is friendly. He sits at the door. I sell bread. He watches people. We are busy. My dog is not a shop assistant. He is a very good friend. His name is Biscuit.

questions.prompt: Where does Kamol work? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I work at a shop” — ish joyi do‘kon.

questions.prompt: What does Kamol sell? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I sell bread” — non sotadi.

questions.prompt: What is the dog's name? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “His name is Biscuit” — itning ismi.

listening.title: The Name Card
listening.text:
Teacher: I am Miss Rose. I teach English.
Pupil: I am Sam. I write my name here.
Teacher: Your name is small on this card.
Pupil: I use a big pen.
Teacher: Now your name is big!
Pupil: I am ready. My pen works hard.

questions.prompt: What does Miss Rose teach? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I teach English” — ingliz tilini o‘qitadi.

questions.prompt: What is the pupil's name? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: O‘quvchi “I am Sam” deydi.

questions.prompt: What does Sam use? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I use a big pen” — katta ruchka ishlatadi.

speaking.prompt: Kamolning do‘konini 30 soniyada tanishtiring. I am … va I sell … orqali sotuvchi rolida gapiring.
success: Bitta be gapi va ikkita harakat gapi bor.
I am sell kabi qo‘shaloq fe’l ishlatilmagan.
Non va it haqidagi ikki fakt saqlangan.

writing.prompt: 20–40 so‘zli do‘kon xodimi kartasini yozing. Ism va gap boshlarini tekshiring.
writing.model: I am Malika. I work at a fruit shop. I sell apples. My shop is small. My cat is quiet. It sits at the door. We are a good team.
success: 20–40 so‘z yozilgan.
I va ism bosh harf bilan yozilgan.
Be va harakat fe’li kamida bittadan to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: sell — sotmoq, bread — non, friendly — do‘stona. Readingdagi I am/I work ni yonma-yon yozing; dialogni bir bor tinglatib kasbni, yana tinglatib ismni topdiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga ega–fe’l kartasi; ilg‘orga ikki xato tartibli gapni tuzdiring. Scaffold: Your, not va hozirgi zamon -s tayyor matn birliklari, yangi qoida sifatida baholanmaydi.

objective: 1-haftadagi so‘z turkumlari va sodda gap qismlarini yangi vaziyatda takrorlayman.

reading.title: Our Tiny Museum
reading.text: We are a museum team. I collect stones. Zebo draws labels. She writes carefully. Our museum is in a box. The box is blue, but the stones are grey. Dad is our visitor. He is happy. We are proud. Our small museum is ready.

questions.prompt: What does the narrator collect? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I collect stones” — toshlar yig‘adi.

questions.prompt: Who draws labels? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Zebo draws labels” — ega Zebo.

questions.prompt: Where is the museum? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Our museum is in a box” — muzey qutida.

listening.title: The Weather Window
listening.text:
Presenter: I am Dilnoza. Our weather station is a window.
Azim: I look outside. The sky is grey.
Presenter: I write slowly. You speak clearly.
Azim: My cat is at the window too. She watches birds.
Presenter: We work together, but the cat is our silent assistant.

questions.prompt: What is the weather station? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Our weather station is a window” — stansiya deraza.

questions.prompt: What colour is the sky? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The sky is grey” — osmon kulrang.

questions.prompt: What does the cat watch? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “She watches birds” — mushuk qushlarni kuzatadi.

speaking.prompt: 45 soniyada o‘zingizning kichik muzeyingizni tanishtiring: buyum, rang, joy va jamoaning bir ishini ayting.
success: Ot, sifat va harakat fe’liga bittadan misol bor.
Bir olmosh va bir joy predlogi mos qo‘llangan.
To‘rtta gapda ega–fe’l tartibi saqlangan.

writing.prompt: 20–40 so‘zda qutidagi boshqa muzey haqida yozing. Oxirida bitta and yoki but gapi bo‘lsin.
writing.model: Our museum is in a green box. I collect shells. My brother writes labels. He writes carefully. Mum is our visitor. The museum is small, but we are proud.
success: 20–40 so‘z bor.
Buyum, ish va joy haqida uch fakt berilgan.
Bosh harf, nuqta va and/but tekshirilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: label — yorliq, stone — tosh, proud — faxrlangan. Bu 6-kun takrorlashi: readingdagi turkumlarni mustaqil belgilang; listeningni ikki marta matnsiz o‘qing, so‘ng dalilni topdiring. Sekin o‘quvchi uchun so‘zlar banki, ilg‘orga yangi besh gapdan turkumlarni ajratish. Scaffold: our va -s shakllari namunalarda qoladi; yangi grammatika kiritmang. Natija faqat ichki mashq uchun.

objective: Am/is/are bilan his va sifatlarni tasdiq hamda inkorda aytaman.

reading.title: Before the Concert
reading.text: I am Daler. I am nervous. My sister is calm. We are at a school concert. Our father is excited. His camera is ready. Our mother is not nervous. She is proud. The hall is warm, but my hands are cold. My sister is not cold. Her coat is thick. We are ready now. My little brother is asleep. He is our quiet fan.

questions.prompt: Who is calm? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My sister is calm” — Dalerning opa yoki singlisi xotirjam.

questions.prompt: What is cold? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My hands are cold” — Dalerning qo‘llari sovuq.

questions.prompt: Who is asleep? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My little brother is asleep” — ukasi uxlayapti.

listening.title: At the Soup Table
listening.text:
Cook: I am hot. The kitchen is warm today.
Helper: I am not hot. I am hungry. Is this soup ready?
Cook: The soup is ready. The bowls are clean. The spoons are not clean.
Helper: My apron is clean too. It is new and yellow.
Cook: We are busy, but we are happy.
Helper: Yes. The soup is orange. My apron and the soup are a colourful team!

questions.prompt: How does the helper feel? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: Yordamchi “I am hungry” deydi.

questions.prompt: Which items are not clean? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The spoons are not clean” — qoshiqlar toza emas.

questions.prompt: What colour is the apron? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “It is new and yellow” — fartuk sariq.

speaking.prompt: Konsert oldida Daler va oilasining holatini 40 soniyada tasvirlang; bitta holatni inkor qiling.
success: Uch kishining holati to‘g‘ri aytiladi.
Am/is/are egaga mos uch marta ishlatiladi.
Bitta not bilan inkor gap bor.

writing.prompt: 25–40 so‘zda bir tadbir oldidagi o‘z holatingiz va ikki yaqin inson holatini yozing.
writing.model: I am nervous before the concert. My friend is calm. Our teacher is proud. We are ready. The room is warm. I am not cold, but my hands are cold!
success: 25–40 so‘z yozilgan.
Am, is va are ning har biri bor.
Bitta sifatli inkor gap yozilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: nervous — hayajonlangan, apron — fartuk, asleep — uxlab yotgan. Readingda hislarni yuz ifodasi bilan ko‘rsating; listeningda kim qandayligini ikki tinglashda jadvalga tushiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga I/he/we ustunlari; ilg‘orga qarama-qarshi ikki holat. Scaffold: Is this soup ready? savolini tayyor tinglash qolipi sifatida tarjima qiling; savol tuzishni keyingi darsda tekshiring.

objective: Be yordamida sifat va kasb haqida savol, tasdiq va inkor tuzaman.

reading.title: The Visitor in a White Coat
reading.text: A visitor is in our classroom. Her coat is white. Is she a doctor? No, she is not a doctor. She is a baker. Her name is Saida. Is she tired? No, she is excited. Her bag is on the desk. The bag is full of bread. Our teacher is a student today. He is very interested. The lesson is about bread, and we are hungry.

questions.prompt: What is Saida's job? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “She is a baker” — novvoy.

questions.prompt: Is Saida tired? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Is she tired? No” — u charchamagan.

questions.prompt: What is in the bag? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The bag is full of bread” — sumkada non.

listening.title: A Curious Passenger
listening.text:
Passenger: Are you a driver?
Woman: No, I am not a driver. I am a guide. Our driver is outside.
Passenger: Is he busy?
Woman: Yes, he is busy. His name is Rustam.
Passenger: Are you tired?
Woman: No, I am happy. Our bus is small, but our group is friendly.
Passenger: I am a teacher. Today I am a tourist. My notebook is ready for interesting names!

questions.prompt: What is the woman's job? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I am a guide” — ayol gid.

questions.prompt: Where is Rustam? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Our driver is outside” va “His name is Rustam” bir odam haqida.

questions.prompt: What is the passenger's job? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: Yo‘lovchi “I am a teacher” deydi.

speaking.prompt: Juftlikda 45 soniyalik tanishuv o‘ynang: biri oq xalatli mehmon. Kasb va holatga oid ikki savol bering.
success: Is/Are bilan ikkita savol aytiladi.
Kasb tasdiq yoki inkor orqali aniqlanadi.
Sifatga oid savolga mos javob beriladi.

writing.prompt: 25–40 so‘zda sinf mehmoni haqida kichik savol-javob yozing.
writing.model: Is our visitor a doctor? No, she is not a doctor. She is a baker. Is she happy? Yes, she is happy. Her bread is warm. Our class is hungry.
success: 25–40 so‘z bor.
Kasb va sifat haqida bittadan savol bor.
Kasb oldida a/an va inkorda not ishlatilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: baker — novvoy, guide — gid, passenger — yo‘lovchi. Readingda kasb taxminini javob bilan tekshiring; listeningni rollarga bo‘lib ikki marta o‘qing. Sekin o‘quvchiga Is she …? qolipi; ilg‘orga uchinchi kasb bilan yangi dialog. Scaffold: full of tayyor ma’no birikmasi; qisqa javoblar hozircha tushunish uchun, to‘liq javob ham qabul qilinadi.

objective: Be + sifat + ot birikmalarini savol, tasdiq va inkorda ishlataman.

reading.title: A Small Hero
reading.text: Bobo is a small dog. He is a friendly animal. Is he a noisy dog? No, he is not a noisy dog. Our neighbour is an old man. His name is Yusuf. Bobo is his quiet friend. Yusuf is a kind neighbour. His garden is beautiful. Bobo is a good garden guard. A cat is on the wall, but Bobo is calm. He is a polite guard!

questions.prompt: Is Bobo a noisy dog? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “He is not a noisy dog” — shovqinchi emas.

questions.prompt: What is the neighbour's name? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “His name is Yusuf” — qo‘shnining ismi.

questions.prompt: Which animal is on the wall? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “A cat is on the wall” — devor ustida mushuk.

listening.title: The Giant Pencil
listening.text:
Rano: Is that a real pencil?
Shopkeeper: Yes. It is a very long pencil. It is a funny present.
Rano: My brother is a young artist. Is this a useful present?
Shopkeeper: It is a useful pencil, but it is not a small pencil.
Rano: His bag is a tiny bag.
Shopkeeper: This blue box is a big box.

teacherNote: Oldindan: teapot — choynak, flowerpot — guldon, bread roll — bulochka. Readingda egalik belgilarini taqqoslang; listeningni ikki marta o‘qib buyum–egasini moslang. Sekin o‘quvchiga ism–buyum chizig‘i; ilg‘orga children's istisno ko‘plik egaligini students' bilan taqqoslash. Scaffold: each — har bir, first/later — avval/keyin tayyor ko‘rsatkichlar.

objective: Ot, artikl, ko‘plik va egalikni 3-hafta takrorlashida birlashtiraman.

reading.title: The Mini Cafe
reading.text: Our classroom is a mini cafe today. A menu is on the door. The menu is short: tea, water and apples. Two children are the waiters. Their teacher is a customer. An empty shoe box is the money box. The children's aprons are clean. A glass of water is on the teacher's table. Her apple is enormous. The cafe's name is Small Bites, but the apples are big!

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada sinf kafesini reklama qiling: menyu, ikki xodim va bitta kishining buyumini ayting.

Children kabi bitta istisno ko‘plik to‘g‘ri.
Artikl va egalik bilan ikki gap bor.

Sekin o‘quvchiga sanalish jadvali; ilg‘orga o‘z menyusida uch artikl tanlovini izohlash. reading.title: A Letter for Grandpa
reading.text: I visit Grandpa on Friday. He knows many stories. I listen to him. My sister visits him too. He shows us an old photo. It is a picture of Grandma on a bicycle. We know her, but the bicycle is new to us. Grandpa keeps it in the garage. Grandma smiles at us. She rides it every Sunday. We call her our racing champion.

questions.prompt: Who shows the photo? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)

questions.prompt: Who is in the photo? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “It is a picture of Grandma” — suratda buvi.

questions.prompt: Where is the bicycle? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)

listening.title: The Puppet Practice
listening.text:
Mila: This is my puppet, King Bean. He likes you, Aziz.
Aziz: I like him too. Is the small puppet your queen?

questions.prompt: Where is the hat? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The king's hat is on the floor” — toj/shlyapa polda.

speaking.prompt: 45 soniyada bobo va buvi hikoyasini ayting; takroriy ismlar o‘rniga he/him/she/her ishlating.
success: Ega o‘rnida he yoki she to‘g‘ri.
To‘ldiruvchi o‘rnida him yoki her to‘g‘ri.
Us yoki them qatnashgan bitta tushunarli gap bor.

writing.prompt: 25–40 so‘zda qarindoshingiz ko‘rsatgan surat haqida yozing.
writing.model: My aunt shows us a photo. We look at it. My uncle is in the photo. We know him. He is on a small bicycle. My aunt smiles at us.
success: 25–40 so‘z yozilgan.
Kamida uch to‘ldiruvchi olmosh bor.
Har bir olmoshning nimaga ishorasi aniq.

teacherNote: Oldindan: garage — garaj, puppet — qo‘g‘irchoq, champion — chempion. Readingda olmoshdan egasiga strelka chizing; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib him/her/it ni belgilang. Sekin o‘quvchiga ega–to‘ldiruvchi juftliklari; ilg‘orga ikki ismni them bilan almashtirish. Scaffold: Present Simple va Give it to me tayyor harakat qoliplari, zamon hamda buyruq qoidalarini baholamang.

objective: My/your kabi egalik aniqlovchilari bilan mine/yours kabi mustaqil egalik olmoshlarini farqlayman.

reading.title: The Identical Umbrellas
reading.text: Our umbrellas are all yellow. My umbrella is by the door. Yours is on the chair. Dilbar's umbrella is on the table. Hers is small. Ours is the enormous family umbrella by the window. The neighbours' umbrella is outside. Theirs is wet. A name label is on every handle. My label is a cat. Your label is a fish. Our rainy day is an animal parade.

questions.prompt: Where is the reader's umbrella? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)

questions.prompt: Whose umbrella is small? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)

questions.prompt: What is on the narrator's label? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My label is a cat” — hikoyachining yorlig‘i mushuk.

listening.title: The Cake Tins
listening.text:
Hasan: Is this your cake tin, Murod?

Hasan: Our tin is silver. Is the silver one ours?

speaking.prompt: 45 soniyalik topilmalar stolida uchta soyabonni egalariga bering: my umbrella/mine kabi almashuvni ko‘rsating.
success: Egalik aniqlovchisidan keyin ot bor.
Mustaqil mine/yours/hers dan keyin ot takrorlanmaydi.
Uchta buyumning egasi aniq aytiladi.

writing.prompt: 25–40 so‘zda ikki o‘xshash buyumni egasi bilan ajratib yozing.
writing.model: My umbrella is yellow. Yours is yellow too. Mine is by the door. Your umbrella is on the chair. My sister's umbrella is red. Hers is small and dry.
success: 25–40 so‘z bor.
My/your bilan ot ikki marta ishlatilgan.
Mine/yours/hers dan ikkitasi mustaqil ishlatilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: handle — tutqich, tin — pishiriq qolipi, round — dumaloq. Readingda buyumlar sxemasini yarating; listeningda egalarni ikki tinglashda tekshiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga my + noun / mine ustunlari; ilg‘orga our/ours va their/theirs farqini yangi gapda ko‘rsatish. Scaffold: every — har bir va bottom — tag qismi kontekstda ko‘rsatiladi.

objective: This/that/these/those va whose orqali yaqin-uzoq buyumlar hamda egalarini aniqlayman.

reading.title: The Costume Table
reading.text: This is our costume table. These hats here are for the singers. Those boots by the wall are for the dancers. That large coat on the chair is the teacher's. Whose red scarf is this? It is Mina's. Her name is on it. These gloves are mine. They are enormous. My costume is a giant rabbit. The rabbit's ears are on the table, beside the singers' hats.

questions.prompt: Who are the hats for? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)

questions.prompt: What animal is the narrator's costume? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My costume is a giant rabbit” — ulkan quyon.

Nargiza: Whose shoes are these here?

success: 25–40 so‘z yozilgan.
To‘rtta ishora so‘zidan kamida uchtasi bor.
Whose savoli va aniq javobi bor.

Sekin o‘quvchiga birlik/ko‘plik belgisi; ilg‘orga buyum masofasini o‘zgartirib gapni yangilash. Scaffold: for the singers — xonandalar uchun tayyor maqsad birikmasi.

objective: One/ones va somebody/nobody/something/nothing orqali takrorni kamaytiraman.

reading.title: The Empty Gift Box
reading.text: Somebody is at the door. It is our neighbour with two gift boxes. The red one is for Mum. The blue one is for me. Something is inside the red box: a lovely scarf. Nothing is inside the blue box. It is a joke! My real present is behind the sofa. Nobody is behind the sofa, just a huge teddy bear. The small bears on my shelf are its new friends.

questions.prompt: Which box is for Mum? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The red one is for Mum” — qizil quti.

questions.prompt: Where is the real present? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My real present is behind the sofa” — divan orqasida.

listening.title: The Glove Search
listening.text:
Coach: Is anybody in the changing room?
Player: Nobody is there. Is something wrong?
Coach: My gloves are missing. The black ones are mine.
Player: The red ones are on the bench. There is something under them.
Coach: My black gloves! The small one is inside the big one.
Player: Is anything else missing?
Coach: Nothing else. My hands are ready for the match now. My gloves are a good hiding place!

questions.prompt: Which gloves belong to the coach? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The black ones are mine” — murabbiyning qora qo‘lqoplari.

speaking.prompt: 45 soniya sovg‘a qutilari haqida topishmoq qiling: rangdan keyin one, ichidagi narsa uchun something/nothing ishlating.
success: One yoki ones mos birlik/ko‘plikda ishlatiladi.
Somebody yoki nobody bilan odam aytiladi.
Something va nothing bir-biriga zid to‘g‘ri vaziyatda aytiladi.

writing.prompt: 25–40 so‘zda ikki qutidagi sirni yozing.
writing.model: Two boxes are on my bed. The green one is mine. Something is inside it: a toy frog. The white one is empty. Nothing is inside it. Nobody is in my room.
success: 25–40 so‘z bor.
One oldingi box otini almashtiradi.
Something/nothing va nobody to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: teddy bear — yumshoq ayiqcha, missing — yo‘qolgan, hiding place — yashirin joy. Readingda one nimani almashtirganini belgilang; listeningdan qo‘lqoplarni ikki tinglashda topdiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga odam/narsa ustunlari; ilg‘orga anybody va anything savollarini tuzdiring. Scaffold: There is something — bitta tayyor borlik iborasi, keyingi hafta mavzusi.

objective: Every/each, o‘zlik olmoshlari va each other ma’nolarini kichik loyiha orqali farqlayman.

reading.title: Our Name Badges
reading.text: Every student has a name badge. Each badge is different. I draw mine myself. My friend Kamila makes hers herself. We help each other with the colours. Our teacher makes his badge himself. His picture is a dinosaur with glasses. We introduce ourselves to the new students. They introduce themselves too. Every name is clear. The teacher's name is clear, but his dinosaur is a little mysterious.

questions.prompt: Who makes Kamila's badge? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Kamila makes hers herself” — Kamila o‘zi.

questions.explanation: “His picture is a dinosaur with glasses” — dinozavr.

questions.prompt: What do the friends help each other with? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “We help each other with the colours” — ranglarni tanlashda.

listening.title: The Sandwich Team
listening.text:
Leader: Every child has a plate. Each plate has a different colour.
Sami: I make my sandwich myself. My sister makes hers herself.
Leader: Good. You help each other with the bread.
Sami: Yes. Our little brother helps himself to cheese.

questions.explanation: “Each plate has a different colour” — rangi turlicha.

questions.prompt: Who helps himself to cheese? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Our little brother helps himself to cheese” — ukasi oladi.

questions.prompt: What colour is Sami's plate? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “A cheese mountain on a blue plate” — Sami likopchasi ko‘k.

speaking.prompt: 45 soniyada nishon tayyorlashni tasvirlang: o‘zingiz qilgan ish, boshqaning o‘zi qilgan ishi va o‘zaro yordamni ayting.
success: Myself va himself/herself egaga mos.
Each other ikki tomonlama yordamni bildiradi.
Every yoki each dan keyin birlik ot ishlatiladi.

success: 25–40 so‘z yozilgan.
Ikki o‘zlik olmoshi to‘g‘ri.
Each other va every/each ma’nosi aniq.

teacherNote: Oldindan: introduce — tanishtirmoq, prepare — tayyorlamoq, dinosaur — dinozavr. Readingda o‘zi/o‘zaro ma’nolarini ajrating; listeningni ikki bor aytib ishni bajarganni ko‘rsating. Sekin o‘quvchiga I–myself juftlari; ilg‘orga ourselves va each other farqiga misol. Scaffold: Present Simple tayyor harakat misollarida; helps himself to — o‘zi olib yeydi iborasini alohida tushuntiring.

objective: Olmosh va egalik shakllarini 4-hafta yakunida chalkash buyumlar vaziyatida qo‘llayman.

reading.title: The Borrowed Art Kit
reading.text: Our art club has a shared box. These brushes are ours. That small brush is mine. Somebody uses it for glue, and now it is stiff. My friend helps me with warm water. We clean it ourselves. Those pencils are hers. She keeps them in a tin. Every pencil has a name label. We help each other, but nobody borrows a brush for glue now. Our brushes are happy again.

questions.prompt: What do they use to clean it? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)

questions.prompt: Where are the friend's pencils? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “She keeps them in a tin” — qalamlar qutichada.

listening.title: The Lost Property Shelf
listening.text:
Helper: Whose lunch box is this?

questions.prompt: What colour is Ziya's lunch box? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)

questions.prompt: Who receives the scarf? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqalik topilmalar stolini boshqaring: uch buyum egasini so‘rang va bittasini olmosh bilan qayta tilga oling.
success: Whose va mos egalik javobi bor.
One/ones kamida bir marta to‘g‘ri.
Me/him/her/us/them dan biri aniq kishiga ishora qiladi.

writing.prompt: 25–40 so‘zda umumiy san’at qutisi uchun qisqa ma’lumot yozing.
writing.model: These brushes are ours. The small one is mine. My friend keeps her pencils in a tin. We help each other. Every pencil has a label. Nobody uses our brushes for glue.
success: 25–40 so‘z bor.
Egalik aniqlovchisi va olmoshi farqlangan.
Every hamda each other to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: shared — umumiy, stiff — qattiqlashgan, owner — egasi. 6-kun: readingda olmoshlar ishorasini mustaqil chizdiring; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib buyumlarni egalariga ulang. Sekin o‘quvchiga ishora jadvali; ilg‘orga noaniq her/their qatnashgan gapni aniqlashtirish. Scaffold: needs va borrows — tayyor harakat fe’llari, yangi zamon qoidasi talab qilinmaydi.

objective: There is/are bilan joydagi bor va yo‘q narsalarni tasvirlayman.

reading.title: The Rooftop Reading Corner
reading.text: There is a reading corner on our roof. There are three chairs and a low table. There is a plant beside each chair. There isn't a roof over the corner, but there is a big umbrella. There aren't any computers. The books are in a dry cupboard. There is a sign on the door: Quiet Reading. Our neighbour's parrot is beside the sign. The parrot is not quiet.

questions.prompt: How many chairs are there? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “There are three chairs” — uchta stul.

questions.prompt: Where are the books? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The books are in a dry cupboard” — quruq shkafda.

questions.prompt: Which animal is noisy? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The parrot is not quiet” — to‘ti tinch emas.

listening.title: The New Bike Room
listening.text:
Caretaker: There is a new bike room beside the stairs. There are six spaces inside.
Student: Are there any bikes here now?
Caretaker: There are two. There isn't a lock on the red bike. There is a lock on the blue one.
Student: There aren't any helmets on the shelf.
Caretaker: They are in the office. There is a little pump by the door too.
Student: A small room for some very tired wheels!

questions.prompt: How many spaces are inside? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “There are six spaces inside” — oltita joy.

questions.prompt: Which bike has no lock? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “There isn't a lock on the red bike” — qizil velosipedda qulf yo‘q.

questions.prompt: Where are the helmets? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “They are in the office” — dubulg‘alar idorada.

speaking.prompt: Tomdagi o‘qish burchagini 60 soniyada mehmon uchun tasvirlang. Uch bor narsa va ikki yo‘q narsani ayting.
success: There is bilan birlik buyum aytiladi.
There are bilan ko‘plik buyum aytiladi.
Isn't va aren't any bilan ikki inkor bor.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda yangi o‘qish burchagi haqida mehmonlar uchun tavsif yozing: joy, jihozlar va mavjud bo‘lmagan ikki qulaylik.
writing.model: There is a reading corner in our garden. There are four chairs and a small table. There is a yellow umbrella over the table. There are books in a wooden box. The box is dry and clean. There isn't a computer in this corner. There aren't any snacks on the table. There is water in a bottle beside the books. The garden is quiet in the morning. Our cat is under a chair. It is a friendly reading partner, but the books are for people.
success: 80–100 so‘z yozilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: roof — tom, lock — qulf, helmet — dubulg‘a. Readingdan burchak rejasini chizing; listeningni ikki marta o‘qib bor/yo‘q ustunlarini to‘ldiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga jihoz rasmlari va ikki gap boshlanishi; ilg‘orga o‘z burchagini besh detal bilan qo‘shish. Scaffold: Are there …? bugun tushunish uchun tayyor savol, ertangi darsda faol mashq qilinadi. Uzun yozuvni avval 4 ta, so‘ng yana 4 ta sodda gap qilib quring.

objective: Is/Are there, How many … are there va qisqa javoblar bilan qulayliklarni tekshiraman.

reading.title: Questions about the Campsite
reading.text: Our family has a campsite information card. Is there a shower? Yes, there is. Are there any shops? No, there aren't. How many toilets are there? There are four. Is there a kitchen? Yes, there is a small shared kitchen. There are two tables outside it. Dad's final question is about a swimming pool. There isn't a pool. There is a lake, and the ducks are its regular swimmers.

questions.prompt: How many toilets are there? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “There are four” oldingi toilets savoliga javob.

questions.prompt: Are there any shops? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Are there any shops? No, there aren't” — do‘kon yo‘q.

questions.prompt: What is there instead of a pool? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “There isn't a pool. There is a lake” — hovuz o‘rniga ko‘l.

listening.title: The Community Room Call
listening.text:
Caller: Is there a room for our chess club?
Manager: Yes, there is. Room two is free.
Caller: How many tables are there?
Manager: There are five tables and twenty chairs.
Caller: Is there a kettle?
Manager: Yes, there is. It is in the little kitchen.
Caller: Are there any chess sets?
Manager: No, there aren't. There is a giant plastic horse, but it isn't a chess piece!

questions.prompt: Which room is free? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Room two is free” — ikkinchi xona bo‘sh.

questions.prompt: How many chairs are there? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Twenty chairs” — yigirmata stul.

questions.prompt: Where is the kettle? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “It is in the little kitchen” — choynak oshxonada.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqalik qo‘ng‘iroqda shaxmat klubi uchun xonani tekshiring: borlik, son va yo‘qlik haqida so‘rang.
success: Is there va Are there savollaridan bittadan bor.
How many savoliga son bilan javob bor.
Yes, there is / No, there aren't mos ishlatiladi.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda klub xonasi bo‘yicha savol-javobli xat yozing. Kamida uch savol va javob kiriting.
writing.model: Hello, our club needs a room for a game afternoon. Is there a free room? Yes, there is a room beside the garden. How many tables are there? There are four tables and sixteen chairs. Is there a kitchen? Yes, there is. The kettle is on the shelf. Are there any board games? No, there aren't. Our games are in our bags. There is a cupboard for our coats. The room is bright and the garden is quiet. It is a good place for our club.
success: 80–100 so‘z yozilgan.
Uchta borlik yoki son savoli va javobi bor.
Javoblardagi jihozlar va sonlar bir-biriga zid emas.

teacherNote: Oldindan: campsite — chodirli dam olish joyi, kettle — elektr choynak, chess set — shaxmat to‘plami. Readingdagi savollarni belgilab ma’lumot kartasiga ko‘chiring; listeningni birinchi umumiy, ikkinchi sonlar uchun o‘qing. Sekin o‘quvchi savol tayanchidan foydalanadi; ilg‘or kartani yopib yangi xona haqida suhbat qiladi. Scaffold: needs — kerak bo‘ladi tayyor fe’l; hozir asosiy baho there savollariga.

objective: There va it farqini, have/has hamda don't/doesn't have bilan egalikni qo‘llayman.

reading.title: The Repair Stall
reading.text: There is a repair stall at our market. It is small and bright. The owner has a red toolbox. His daughter has a notebook for customers' names. They have a bicycle stand too. They don't have a car lift. The owner doesn't have a uniform, but he has a very colourful apron. There is a bell on the table. It is loud. Every broken bicycle gets a cheerful welcome.

questions.prompt: What colour is the toolbox? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The owner has a red toolbox” — qizil.

questions.prompt: What does the daughter have? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “His daughter has a notebook” — daftar.

questions.prompt: What lift do they not have? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “They don't have a car lift” — mashina ko‘targich yo‘q.

listening.title: The Club Camera
listening.text:
Amina: There is a camera in our club cupboard. It is old but useful.
Jasur: Do we have a charger?
Amina: Yes. I have it in my bag. Sara has a memory card.
Jasur: I don't have a camera. My phone doesn't have much space.
Amina: Our club has a tripod too. It is by the window.
Jasur: Excellent. There is a perfect subject outside: a pigeon on the mayor's statue!

questions.prompt: Where is the camera? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “There is a camera in our club cupboard” — shkafda.

questions.prompt: Who has the memory card? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Sara has a memory card” — Sarada.

questions.prompt: Where is the tripod? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “It is by the window” — tripod deraza yonida.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada ta’mirlash shoxobchasini tavsiflang: avval joyni kiriting, it bilan davom eting, egadagi va yo‘q jihozni ayting.
success: There is dan so‘ng it o‘sha narsaga ishora qiladi.
Have va has egaga mos.
Don't have yoki doesn't have bilan bir inkor bor.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda surat klubi jihozlarini tanishtiring. Klub va ikki a’zoning egaligini ajrating.
writing.model: There is a photography club at our school. It is in a small room near the hall. Our club has an old camera and a tripod. I have a memory card. My friend has a charger in her bag. We don't have a printer in our room. Our teacher doesn't have a club camera, but he has a good phone. There is a large cupboard beside the door. It is for our equipment. Our first subject is the school garden. The flowers are ready for their photograph.
success: 80–100 so‘z bor.
There/it bilan yangi va ma’lum buyum ajratilgan.
Have/has va ikkita egalik inkori to‘g‘ri.

teacherNote: Oldindan: toolbox — asbob qutisi, charger — quvvatlagich, tripod — uch oyoqli tayanch. Readingda yangi buyum va it ishorasini ulang; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib kimda nima borligini yozdiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga have/has jadvali; ilg‘orga yetishmayotgan jihoz bilan aniq inkor. Scaffold: gets a welcome va Do we have …? tayyor tushunish qoliplari; savol ertaga faol o‘tiladi.

objective: Do/Does … have savollari va have/has got tasdiq-inkorini vaziyatga mos ishlataman.

reading.title: The Costume Checklist
reading.text: Our drama club has got a costume checklist. Have we got a crown? Yes, we have got a paper crown. The king has got a purple coat. He hasn't got any boots. The queen has got silver shoes, but she hasn't got a necklace. Do we have a mirror? Yes, we do. Does the dragon have wings? No, it doesn't. Our dragon has got a bicycle helmet and a very long scarf.

questions.prompt: What is the crown made of? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “A paper crown” — toj qog‘ozdan.

questions.prompt: What hasn't the queen got? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “She hasn't got a necklace” — marjoni yo‘q.

questions.prompt: Does the dragon have wings? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Does the dragon have wings? No” — qanoti yo‘q.

listening.title: The Day Trip Bags
listening.text:
Guide: Do you have your tickets, Farida?
Farida: Yes. I've got three tickets in my pocket.
Guide: Does your brother have a water bottle?
Farida: Yes. He's got a big one. I haven't got a hat, though.
Guide: Our spare hat is in this bag. Your brother hasn't got a map.
Farida: We've got one map between us. My brother has got the snacks. He's the important member of our team!

questions.prompt: How many tickets has Farida got? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I've got three tickets” — uchta chipta.

questions.prompt: What hasn't Farida got? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I haven't got a hat” — shlyapasi yo‘q.

questions.prompt: Who has the snacks? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My brother has got the snacks” — yeguliklar akasi/ukasida.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada sahna jamoasining ro‘yxatini tekshiring: sherigingizdan ikki jihozni so‘rang, got bilan javob bering.
success: Do you have va Does he/she have savollari bor.
Have got va has got egaga mos.
Haven't got yoki hasn't got bilan yo‘q buyum aytiladi.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda sayohatga tayyorlikni tekshiruvchi xabar yozing. Ikki savol, bor va yo‘q buyumlarni kiriting.
writing.model: Our bags are ready for the museum trip. I've got two tickets and a small map. My sister has got a bottle of water. She hasn't got a hat, but there is a spare one in my bag. Do you have a notebook? My sister has got one for her drawings. Does your brother have a pencil? We have got two extra pencils. We haven't got any sandwiches. The cafe at the museum has food. Our bags are light, but our water bottle is very big.
success: 80–100 so‘z yozilgan.
Do/Does have bilan ikkita savol bor.
Got bilan ikki tasdiq va ikki inkor to‘g‘ri.

teacherNote: Oldindan: crown — toj, necklace — marjon, spare — zaxira. Readingni nazorat ro‘yxati qilib o‘qing; listeningda ikki marta kimning sumkasida nima borligini belgilang. Sekin o‘quvchiga have va gotni bir rangda bering; ilg‘orga bir gapni have/have got bilan qayta aytish. Scaffold: Have we got …? tayyor namuna, ertangi darsda qisqa javobi faol o‘tiladi.

objective: Have got qisqa javoblari, buyruq va let's takliflari bilan hamkorlik qilaman.

reading.title: The Paper Bridge Challenge
reading.text: Our team has got paper, tape and two books. The challenge is a paper bridge between the books. Put the books on the table. Leave a small gap. Fold the paper carefully. Don't use all the tape. Let's test the bridge with a coin. Let's not use the teacher's phone! The coin is on the bridge. Our bridge is strong. The phone is safe in the teacher's pocket.

questions.prompt: What goes on the bridge for the test? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Let's test the bridge with a coin” — tanga.

questions.prompt: What should they not use all of? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Don't use all the tape” — lentani hammasini ishlatmaslik.

questions.prompt: Where is the teacher's phone? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Safe in the teacher's pocket” — ustoz cho‘ntagida.

listening.title: The Seed Pots
listening.text:
Leader: Have you got your pots?
Children: Yes, we have.
Leader: Has Lina got a spoon?
Lina: No, I haven't.
Leader: Here is one. Put soil in the pot. Don't fill it to the top.
Lina: Have we got enough water?
Leader: Yes, we have. Let's put one seed in each pot. Let's not flood the table.
Lina: My seed has a tiny home now. Its address is Pot Number Three.

questions.prompt: What hasn't Lina got at first? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Has Lina got a spoon? … No, I haven't” — dastlab qoshiq yo‘q.

questions.prompt: How many seeds go in each pot? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “One seed in each pot” — bittadan urug‘.

questions.prompt: What is Lina's pot number? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Its address is Pot Number Three” — uchinchi tuvak.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada sherigingizga qog‘oz ko‘prik tayyorlatish bo‘yicha ko‘rsatma bering; avval jihozini so‘rang.
success: Have you got savoli va qisqa javob bor.
Ikki buyruq va bir Don't buyrug‘i aytiladi.
Let's va let's not bilan mos taklif beriladi.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda yangi jamoa uchun qog‘oz ko‘prik yo‘riqnomasini yozing: jihoz tekshiruvi, qadamlar va sinov.
writing.model: Have you got two books and a sheet of paper? Have you got some tape? Put the books on a table. Leave a gap between them. Fold your paper carefully. Put the paper across the gap. Use a little tape at each end. Don't put a heavy bag on your bridge. Let's test it with a small coin first. Let's not use a glass of water. Our table is for paper, not for a flood! Give your bridge a name. Ours is the Tiny River Bridge.
success: 80–100 so‘z bor.
Kamida uch harakat ko‘rsatmasi aniq ketma-ketlikda.
Have got savoli, Don't va Let's shakllari bor.

teacherNote: Oldindan: tape — yopishqoq lenta, seed — urug‘, soil — tuproq. Readingni xavfsiz qog‘oz buyumlar bilan ko‘rsating; listeningni avval tinglab tartiblang, keyin yana tekshiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga qadam rasmlari; ilg‘orga uchta o‘z ko‘rsatmasini qo‘shish. Scaffold: enough — yetarli, flood — suvga bostirmoq kontekst orqali tushuntiriladi; amaliy topshiriqda telefon yoki suv bilan sinov qilmang.

objective: 5-haftadagi borlik, egalik, savol va ko‘rsatmalarni bir loyihada takrorlayman.

reading.title: A Welcome Box
reading.text: There is a welcome box for new students in our classroom. It has got a map, a notebook and a pencil. There aren't any sweets in it. Every new student has a name card. Do they have a timetable? Yes, the timetable is in the notebook. Open the first page. Don't lose the little map. Let's add a friendly message. Our class has many helpers, not just one teacher.

questions.prompt: What is not in the welcome box? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “There aren't any sweets in it” — konfet yo‘q.

questions.prompt: Where is the timetable? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The timetable is in the notebook. Open the first page” — daftar boshida.

questions.prompt: What do they suggest adding? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Let's add a friendly message” — iliq xabar.

listening.title: The Street Clean-up Kit
listening.text:
Organiser: Is there a bag for every team?
Helper: Yes, there is. Each team has got two pairs of gloves too.
Organiser: Have you got the map?
Helper: Yes, I have. There are three streets on it.
Organiser: Good. Don't pick up broken glass. Ask an adult. Put paper in the blue bag.
Helper: Let's start by the park.
Organiser: Yes. Let's not forget our water. Clean streets and thirsty helpers aren't a good team.

questions.prompt: How many pairs of gloves does each team have? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Two pairs of gloves” — ikki juft.

questions.prompt: How many streets are on the map? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “There are three streets on it” — uch ko‘cha.

questions.prompt: Which bag is for paper? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Put paper in the blue bag” — ko‘k xalta.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada yangi o‘quvchiga kutib olish qutisini tanishtiring, bir buyum haqida so‘rang va ikki ko‘rsatma bering.
success: There is/are bilan quti tarkibi aytiladi.
Have/has got savoli yoki tasdig‘i to‘g‘ri.
Bitta tasdiq va bitta inkor buyruq bor.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda yangi sinfdosh uchun kutib olish varaqasini yozing: sinf, quti, savol va ikki ko‘rsatma.
writing.model: Welcome to our class. There is a welcome box on your desk. It has got a pencil, a notebook and a map. There are two doors in our classroom. The door by the window is for the garden. Have you got your name card? Put it on your desk. Open the notebook at the first page. Your timetable is there. Don't leave your map in the box. It is useful for the whole school. Let's look at the library together. Our class is small, but our welcome is big.
success: 80–100 so‘z yozilgan.
Borlik va egalik ma’nolari to‘g‘ri ajratilgan.
Kamida ikki ko‘rsatma va bir savol bor.

teacherNote: Oldindan: timetable — dars jadvali, gloves — qo‘lqop, adult — katta yoshli kishi. 6-kun readingni quti ro‘yxatiga aylantiring; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib buyum va qoidalarni ajrating. Sekin o‘quvchiga 4 gaplik tayanchdan boshlab kengaytirish; ilg‘orga boshqa maktab xonasi uchun quti yaratish. Yangi grammatika kiritmang; yozuvdagi xatolardan ikki aniq qayta mashq tanlang.

objective: Present Simple tasdiqda I/we/they va he/she/it fe’l shakllarini, -s/-es/-ies imlosini qo‘llayman.

reading.title: The Sunrise Bakery
reading.text: We open our bakery at six. I mix the dough, and my brother washes the trays. Our mother carries bread to the front window. She arranges it carefully. My brother watches the oven. I study English after lunch. Our customers arrive early. They buy warm bread and chat at the door. A grey cat waits outside every morning. It watches the bread, but its breakfast is at home.

questions.prompt: What time does the bakery open? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “We open our bakery at six” — soat oltida.

questions.prompt: Who washes the trays? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “My brother washes the trays” — aka/uka.

questions.prompt: When does the narrator study English? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I study English after lunch” — tushlikdan keyin.

listening.title: The School News Team
listening.text:
Editor: We make our school news on Fridays. I write the headlines.
Reporter: I interview students. Lola takes photos. She carries her camera in a red bag.
Editor: Timur checks the names. He studies the list carefully.
Reporter: Our teacher reads the final page. She fixes small mistakes.
Editor: Then we share the news with every class.
Reporter: My favourite story is about our caretaker. He teaches his parrot the school song!

questions.prompt: When does the team make the news? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “On Fridays” — juma kunlari.

questions.prompt: Who takes photos? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Lola takes photos” — suratni Lola oladi.

questions.prompt: Who checks the names? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Timur checks the names” — Timur tekshiradi.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada novvoyxona jamoasidagi uch kishining odatiy ishini ayting; keyin o‘z ishingizni qo‘shing.
success: I/we bilan fe’lning asosiy shakli bor.
He/she bilan kamida uchta -s shakli bor.
Washes yoki carries kabi bitta imlo o‘zgarishi to‘g‘ri aytiladi.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda maktab yangiliklar jamoangizning haftalik ishini yozing; kim nima qilishini taqsimlang.
writing.model: We make a class newspaper every Friday. I write short stories about our lessons. My friend takes photos of our projects. She carries her camera in a green bag. Our editor checks every name and fixes small mistakes. He studies the page carefully. We share the newspaper with our families. My mother reads it after dinner. She enjoys the funny pictures. Our teacher keeps a copy in the classroom. The newspaper tells our story, and every student has a job. I enjoy my job as a writer.
success: 80–100 so‘z bor.
Kamida uchta shaxsning vazifasi aniq.
-s, -es va -ies shakllariga to‘g‘ri misollar bor.

teacherNote: Oldindan: dough — xamir, tray — patnis, headline — sarlavha. Readingda jamoa ishlarini jadvalga yozing; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib ism–fe’lni moslang. Sekin o‘quvchiga I wash/he washes jufti; ilg‘orga carry/study imlosini izohlash. Oldingi darslardagi harakat namunalari endi Present Simple qoidasi bilan tizimlashtiriladi.

objective: Goes/does/has va don't/doesn't orqali kundalik faoliyatdagi bor-yo‘q odatlarni aytaman.

reading.title: The Quiet Delivery Rider
reading.text: Aziz delivers books by bicycle. He goes to the library at nine. He has a large basket on his bike. He does the heavy deliveries first. He doesn't carry food, and he doesn't work at night. His customers don't pay him; the library runs this service for older readers. Aziz likes the quiet streets. His bicycle doesn't have a loud horn. It has a tiny bell with a surprisingly confident voice.

questions.prompt: What does Aziz deliver? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Aziz delivers books” — kitoblar eltadi.

questions.prompt: When does he go to the library? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “He goes to the library at nine” — soat to‘qqizda.

questions.prompt: Do customers pay Aziz? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “His customers don't pay him” — mijozlar unga pul bermaydi.

listening.title: The No-Screen Evening
listening.text:
Brother: We don't watch television on Wednesdays.
Sister: Dad does the cooking, and Mum goes to her singing club.
Brother: I don't play games on my phone. I make models from cardboard.
Sister: My brother has a whole cardboard city. It doesn't have an airport.
Brother: My planes don't fit on the table.
Sister: I read stories aloud. Dad doesn't sing with Mum, but he sings to the soup!

questions.prompt: On which day do they avoid television? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “On Wednesdays” — chorshanba kuni.

questions.prompt: Where does Mum go? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Mum goes to her singing club” — ashula klubiga.

questions.prompt: What does the cardboard city lack? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “It doesn't have an airport” — aeroporti yo‘q.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada Azizning ish kuni va o‘zingizning bir odatingizni ayting. Uch inkor yordamida chegaralarni tushuntiring.
success: Goes/does/has dan ikkitasi ishlatiladi.
Doesn't dan keyin fe’l asosiy shaklda.
Don't va doesn't bilan kamida bittadan gap bor.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda ekranlarsiz bir oqshomdagi oilaviy odatlarni yozing; nimalar qilinmasligini ham ayting.
writing.model: We have a quiet evening every Wednesday. We don't watch television, and we don't use our phones at dinner. My father does the cooking. My mother goes to her singing club after work. My brother makes paper boats. He doesn't make planes because our room is small. I read a story to my grandmother. She has a favourite chair by the window. She doesn't sleep during the story. She listens carefully and asks questions. Our evening doesn't need a screen. It has food, stories and a small paper fleet.
success: 80–100 so‘z yozilgan.
Uch odat va uch inkor aniq.
Doesn't dan keyin -s qo‘shilmagan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: deliver — yetkazmoq, horn — signal, cardboard — karton. Readingda xizmatning nimalarni qilmasligini belgilang; listeningni ikki marta o‘qib oila faoliyatini to‘ldiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga doesn't + asosiy fe’l ramkasi; ilg‘orga uch tasdiqni inkorga aylantirish. Runs this service — xizmatni yuritadi va fleet — kemalar guruhi mazmun tayanchi sifatida tushuntiriladi.

objective: Do/does va wh-savollar bilan kundalik hayot haqida ma’lumot yig‘aman.

reading.title: An Interview with a Clock Repairer
reading.text: Where does Mr Hasan work? He works in a tiny shop near the station. Does he repair watches too? Yes, he repairs watches and clocks. When does he open? He opens at ten. What does he do at lunch? He closes the shop and walks in the park. Do the clocks all show the same time? No. Some are broken. Mr Hasan checks his phone for the correct time.

questions.prompt: Where is the shop? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “A tiny shop near the station” — bekat yaqinida.

questions.prompt: What time does it open? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “He opens at ten” — soat o‘nda.

questions.prompt: What does he check for the correct time? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Checks his phone for the correct time” — telefoniga qaraydi.

listening.title: A New Club Member
listening.text:
Leader: Do you live near our garden club, Salim?
Salim: Yes. I live above the bakery.
Leader: What do you grow at home?
Salim: I grow mint in a pot. My sister grows tomatoes.
Leader: Does she come here on Saturdays?
Salim: No. She works on Saturdays.
Leader: When do you water your mint?
Salim: In the morning. My cat watches me. It doesn't help with the watering!

questions.prompt: Where does Salim live? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I live above the bakery” — novvoyxona tepasida.

questions.prompt: What does Salim grow? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I grow mint” — yalpiz yetishtiradi.

questions.prompt: When does he water it? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “In the morning” — ertalab sug‘oradi.

speaking.prompt: Soatsoz bilan 60–75 soniyalik intervyu qiling: joy, vaqt, ish va tushlik haqidagi to‘rt savolni navbat bilan bering.
success: Do va does egaga mos tanlangan.
Kamida ikkita wh-savol bor.
Savollardan keyin fe’lning asosiy shakli ishlatilgan.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda bog‘ klubining yangi a’zosi bilan savol-javob yozing: joy, o‘simlik va parvarish vaqtini so‘rang.

objective: 6-haftadagi Present Simple shakllarini kundalik xizmat haqida yaxlit qo‘llayman.

reading.title: The Neighbourhood Book Cart
reading.text: Our neighbourhood has a book cart. Two volunteers push it to the park every Sunday. They don't sell the books. People borrow one and bring it back the next week. speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada ko‘ngilli xizmatini tanishtiring, so‘ng sherikning ikki savoliga javob bering.
success: Ikki tasdiq va bir inkor odat gapi bor.
Do/does bilan savol-javob egaga mos.

writing.model: Our book cart visits the park every Sunday. We don't sell books. People borrow them and return them the next week. Malika writes readers' names in a notebook. Sekin o‘quvchiga vazifa–odam jadvali; ilg‘orga o‘xshash yangi xizmatni himoya qilish. Natijani ichki mashq sifatida yozing, standart imtihon bali bermang.

reading.title: The Mural in Progress

success: Am/is/are egaga mos.
To‘rtta harakat -ing shaklida.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda sinf rasmini hozir kuzatayotgandek yozing: odamlar, ishlar va ikki inkor.

Sekin o‘quvchiga be + fe’l-ing kartalari; ilg‘orga ikki kuzatuvni inkorga aylantirish. reading.title: The Live Kitchen Screen

Sekin o‘quvchiga savol kartalari; ilg‘orga javobdan yangi why savoli. Scaffold: without crowding — tiqilinch qilmasdan va for one more minute — yana bir daqiqa tayyor birikmalar.

Sekin o‘quvchiga run→running va lie→lying kartalari; ilg‘orga cut/sit/plan misollarini mustaqil yasash. Talaffuz mashqida qo‘sh undoshni ortiqcha cho‘zdirish shart emas, imlosiga e’tibor qarating.

Sekin o‘quvchiga vaqt chizig‘i; ilg‘orga bir harakatni now/this month kontekstlarida ishlatish. Supervising — nazorat qilmoqda so‘zini mushukning kulgili roli orqali tushuntiring.
