listening.text:
Customer: You usually serve drinks in paper cups. Why are you using mugs today?
Owner: We are reducing our waste. More customers are bringing their own cups too.
Customer: I like that idea. I don't need a paper cup.
Owner: Our assistant is washing the mugs now. He usually works at the till.
Customer: Does he enjoy washing up?
Owner: He prefers the till, but he understands the plan. Our sink is becoming a very busy place.

questions.prompt: What does the cafe usually use? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Usually serve drinks in paper cups” — qog‘oz stakan.

questions.prompt: What is the assistant doing now? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Washing the mugs now” — krujkalarni yuvmoqda.

questions.prompt: Where does the assistant prefer working? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “He prefers the till” — kassani afzal ko‘radi.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada kafe o‘zgarishini tushuntiring: odatiy holat, bugungi ish va fikringizni ayting.
success: Usually bilan Present Simple ishlatiladi.
Now/today bilan Continuous ishlatiladi.
Like/know/want kabi holat fe’li keraksiz -ing olmaydi.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda mahallangizdagi bir ijobiy o‘zgarishni odatlaringiz bilan bog‘lab yozing.
writing.model: Our street is becoming greener. People usually keep plants inside their homes, but this month many neighbours are putting pots outside. I walk to school along this street every day. I like the new flowers, and I know several neighbours by name. Today, the shop owner is watering his plants near the door. He usually opens his shop at nine. He believes a friendly street is good for everyone. My brother wants a huge tree for our balcony. I understand his idea, but our balcony needs a small plant.
success: 80–100 so‘z bor.
Odat va o‘zgarish uchun ikki zamon to‘g‘ri ajratilgan.
Kamida uch holat fe’li Simple shaklida.

teacherNote: Oldindan: balcony — balkon, waste — chiqindi, till — kassa. Readingda odat/o‘zgarish/fikrni uch rangda belgilang; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib usually/now juftlarini topdiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga like/know/want banki; ilg‘orga o‘zgarishni bir dalil bilan asoslash. Scaffold: am seeing bu yerda ko‘zga qayta-qayta tashlanayotgan vaqtinchalik tajriba; sodda qoida uchun asosiy ishlab chiqarishda see ni Simple bilan qo‘llang.

objective: 7-haftada o‘tilgan Continuous shakllarini Simple bilan birgalikda mustaqil qo‘llayman.

reading.title: Open Day behind the Scenes
reading.text: Our school holds an open day every year. Today, students are showing visitors their projects. I usually work in the science room, but now I am guiding parents through the garden. Two friends are testing a small water wheel. It isn't turning fast because the water flow is weak. Our teacher is carrying a bucket. She knows a simple solution. The parents are watching, and one little child is cheering for the wheel.

questions.prompt: What is the narrator doing now? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Now I am guiding parents through the garden” — ota-onalarni bog‘da olib yurmoqda.

questions.prompt: Why is the wheel not turning fast? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
answers: because the water flow is weak
questions.explanation: “Because the water flow is weak” — suv oqimi kuchsiz.

questions.prompt: What is the teacher carrying? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Our teacher is carrying a bucket” — chelak.

listening.title: The Station Piano
listening.text:
Presenter: What are you playing today, Mariam?
Mariam: A simple folk song. I usually practise at home, but this week I am playing at the station.
Presenter: Are people stopping to listen?
Mariam: Yes, they are. A little boy is dancing by his suitcase.
Presenter: Do you know him?
Mariam: No, I don't. His father is filming him. I love this piano. It gives waiting passengers something cheerful.
Presenter: The station has its own tiny concert now.

questions.prompt: Where does Mariam usually practise? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I usually practise at home” — odatda uyda.

questions.prompt: What is the boy doing? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “A little boy is dancing” — bola raqsga tushmoqda.

questions.prompt: Does Mariam know the boy? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: Mariam “No, I don't” deb javob beradi — u bolani tanimaydi.

speaking.prompt: 60–75 soniyada ochiq eshiklar kunidan jonli xabar bering. Odatni hozirgi ishga solishtiring va sherik savoliga javob bering.
success: Odat uchun Simple, hozir uchun Continuous to‘g‘ri.
Bitta inkor va bitta qisqa javob bor.
Know/like/want dan biri Simple shaklida.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda stansiyadagi kichik konsertni kuzatayotgan do‘stingiz nomidan xabar yozing.
writing.model: I am waiting at the station with my father. A woman is playing a folk song on the piano. She usually practises at home, but this week she is playing here. Several passengers are standing near her. A little boy is dancing beside his suitcase. His father is filming him. Are people enjoying the music? Yes, they are. I don't know the musician, but I like her song. Our train isn't here yet. We usually read while we wait. Today, we are listening to a free concert.
success: 80–100 so‘z yozilgan.
Odat va vaqtinchalik ishlar aniq.
Bir Continuous savol-javobi va bir Simple inkori bor.

teacherNote: Oldindan: water wheel — suv g‘ildiragi, flow — oqim, folk song — xalq qo‘shig‘i. 6-kun readingda hozir/odatni mustaqil ajrating; listeningni ikki marta o‘qib dalillarni qayd eting. Sekin o‘quvchiga ikki vaqt ustuni; ilg‘orga stansiyadagi uchinchi shaxs nuqtayi nazaridan xabar. Bu ichki mashq; ravonlikdan tashqari ma’no va shaklga aniq fikr bering.

objective: What/which, who/whose va why/how savollarini maqsadga mos tanlayman.

reading.title: Choosing the Club Poster
reading.text: Our club needs a poster. What is the event? It is a neighbourhood picnic. Which design do we prefer, the green one or the blue one? We prefer the green one. Who is drawing it? Our friend Dilfuza is drawing it. Whose camera are we using? We are using her brother's camera. Why is there a giant spoon in the picture? It represents our shared meal. How are we printing the posters? On the school printer.

questions.prompt: Which design do they prefer? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “We prefer the green one” — yashil dizayn.

questions.prompt: Whose camera are they using? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Her brother's camera” — Dilfuzaning akasi/ukasining kamerasi.

questions.prompt: How are they printing the posters? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “On the school printer” — maktab printerida.

listening.title: Finding a Chess Partner
listening.text:
Organiser: What game do you enjoy, Pavel?
Pavel: Chess. Which table is for beginners, this one or that one?
Organiser: This one. Who is your partner?
Pavel: My cousin. Whose clock is on the table?
Organiser: It's mine.
Pavel: Why do we need it?
Organiser: It measures each player's time.
Pavel: How do we start?
Organiser: Move a piece, then press the clock. The clock is strict, but your cousin is friendly!

questions.prompt: Which table is for beginners? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “This one” — tashkilotchi yaqin stolni ko‘rsatadi.

questions.prompt: Who owns the clock? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: Tashkilotchi “It's mine” deydi.

questions.prompt: What should Pavel do after moving a piece? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Move a piece, then press the clock” — keyin soatni bosadi.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada afisha rejasi bo‘yicha suhbat qiling: what/which va who/whose farqini amalda ko‘rsating.
success: Which aniq ikki variantga oid.
Who odamni, whose egani so‘raydi.
Why sabab, how usul haqidagi javob oladi.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda klub afishasi uchun savol-javobli reja yozing.
writing.model: What is our event? It is a picnic for our neighbours. Which poster do we like, the green one or the yellow one? We like the yellow one because it looks sunny. Who is drawing the main picture? Dilfuza is drawing a large picnic basket. Whose camera are we using? We are using my brother's camera for a group photo. Why do we need a photo? It introduces our team. How are we sharing the poster? We are putting copies in the library and near the school gate.
success: 80–100 so‘z yozilgan.
Olti savol so‘zi maqsadga mos ishlatilgan.
Har bir savolga aniq mos javob berilgan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: design — dizayn, represent — ifodalamoq, measure — o‘lchamoq. Readingda savollarni ma’lumot turiga ajrating; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib kim/kimniki farqini tekshiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga o‘zbekcha ma’no kartalari; ilg‘orga bitta javobga ikki xil savol tuzdiring. Move … then press buyruqlari oldingi haftadan qaytariladi.

objective: Yosh, masofa, davomiylik va miqdorni so‘rayman, Who + fe’l ega savolini tuzaman.

reading.title: The Old Footbridge
reading.text: Our village footbridge is eighty years old. It is fifty metres from the bus stop. The walk across it takes two minutes. How many people use it each day? About sixty people use it. How much does it cost to cross? Nothing; it is free. Who checks the bridge? A council worker checks it every Monday. Our oldest neighbour calls it the young bridge. She is ninety, so she has a point.

questions.prompt: How old is the bridge? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Eighty years old” — sakson yoshda.

questions.prompt: How far is it from the bus stop? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Fifty metres from the bus stop” — ellik metr.

questions.prompt: Who checks it? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “A council worker checks it” — mahalliy idora xodimi.

listening.title: Joining the Pottery Session
listening.text:
Caller: How long is the pottery session?
Teacher: Ninety minutes.
Caller: How many students are in each group?
Teacher: Eight. Everyone has a work space.
Caller: How much clay do we use?
Teacher: About half a kilo each.
Caller: Who brings the tools?
Teacher: I bring them. You bring an apron.
Caller: How old is your youngest student?
Teacher: Seven. Her bowls are small, but her ideas are enormous.

questions.prompt: How long is the session? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Ninety minutes” — to‘qson daqiqa.

questions.prompt: How many students are in a group? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Eight” — guruhda sakkiz kishi.

questions.prompt: Who brings the tools? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: O‘qituvchi “I bring them” deydi — asboblarni u keltiradi.

speaking.prompt: 60–75 soniyada mahalladagi ko‘prik yoki kurs haqida ma’lumot so‘rang: yosh, masofa yoki vaqt, son va mas’ul kishi.
success: How old/long/far dan ikkitasi mos.
How much/how many sanalishga mos.
Who + fe’l savolida ortiqcha do ishlatilmaydi.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda kulolchilik darsi uchun ma’lumot sahifasini savol-javob bilan yozing.
writing.model: How long is our pottery class? It lasts ninety minutes. How many students are in the group? There are eight students, and each student has a table space. How much clay does each person use? About half a kilo. Who brings the tools? Our teacher brings them in a large box. Students bring their own aprons. How old is the youngest student? She is seven. She makes tiny bowls for her toy animals. The class is friendly, and beginners are welcome. Your first bowl doesn't need to be perfect.
success: 80–100 so‘z bor.
Vaqt, son va miqdor aniq ko‘rsatilgan.
Bitta to‘g‘ri ega savoli va javobi bor.

teacherNote: Oldindan: footbridge — piyodalar ko‘prigi, pottery — kulolchilik, clay — loy. Readingdagi o‘lchovlarni birliklari bilan yozdiring; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib sonlarni tekshiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga years/metres/minutes ustunlari; ilg‘orga who checks va what does he check farqini ayttiring. Has a point — gapida jon bor iborasini tayyor ma’no sifatida tushuntiring.

objective: To‘ldiruvchi savollari va joy predloglari orqali odam-buyumlarni topaman.

reading.title: The Museum Desk Puzzle
reading.text: Our museum guide keeps the tickets in a drawer. She puts the map on the desk. A small clock is between the map and a lamp. What does she check first each morning? She checks the visitor list. Who does she call after that? She calls the caretaker. His office is behind the gift shop. Today, her pen is under the visitor book. The guide knows every ancient object, but her pen is a daily mystery.

questions.prompt: What does the guide check first? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “She checks the visitor list” — tashrifchilar ro‘yxati.

questions.prompt: Who does she call? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “She calls the caretaker” — xo‘jalik xodimi.

questions.prompt: Where is her pen today? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Her pen is under the visitor book” — tashrif daftarining ostida.

listening.title: The Rehearsal Room
listening.text:
Director: Who do you need for this scene?
Actor: I need Madina. Where is she?
Director: She is at the piano. What are you looking for?
Actor: My script. Is it on the chair?
Director: No. It is in the bag between the two chairs.
Actor: The red bag?
Director: Yes. Your hat is behind the piano too.
Actor: My things know their places. I am the only confused person here!

questions.prompt: Who does the actor need? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “I need Madina” — Madina kerak.

questions.prompt: Where is the script? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
answers: in the bag between the chairs
questions.explanation: “It is in the bag between the two chairs” joyni bildiradi; “The red bag?” savoliga “Yes” javobi sumkaning qizilligini tasdiqlaydi.

questions.prompt: Where is the hat? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Your hat is behind the piano” — pianino orqasida.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqa muzey stolidagi buyumlarni topish o‘yinini o‘ynang: ikki to‘ldiruvchi savoli va uch joy javobi.
success: What/Who does …? shakli to‘g‘ri.
In/on/at dan ikkitasi mos.
Under/behind/between bilan aniq joy aytiladi.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda yangi muzey xodimiga ish joyini tushuntiruvchi savol-javob yozing.
writing.model: What does our guide check every morning? She checks the visitor list in the blue folder. Who does she call after that? She calls the caretaker. His office is behind the gift shop. The tickets are in the drawer under the desk. The map is on the desk, between the clock and the lamp. Our guide meets visitors at the front door. Where does she keep her pen? It is usually in her pocket, but today it is under the visitor book. The desk has a place for everything.
success: 80–100 so‘z yozilgan.
Kamida ikki to‘ldiruvchi savoli bor.
To‘rtta joy birikmasi bir-biriga zid emas.

teacherNote: Oldindan: drawer — tortma, caretaker — xo‘jalik xodimi, script — sahna matni. Readingdan stol chizmasini tuzing; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib buyumlarni qo‘ying. Sekin o‘quvchiga predlog rasm kartalari; ilg‘orga who calls/who does she call juftini izohlash. Looking for — qidirmoq tayyor birikma sifatida ko‘rsatiladi.

objective: Harakat va vaqt predloglari bilan yo‘l hamda kun tartibini aniq tushuntiraman.

reading.title: The Morning Market Route
reading.text: On Saturdays, I walk to the market with my aunt. We leave at eight in the morning. We go across the bridge and into the covered market. My aunt buys vegetables before breakfast. I carry the empty bags until we reach her favourite stall. After shopping, we walk out of the market and sit in the park. Our bags are full, but my aunt always finds space for one more bunch of herbs.

questions.prompt: When do they leave? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “We leave at eight in the morning” — ertalab sakkizda.

questions.prompt: What do they cross? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “We go across the bridge” — ko‘prikdan o‘tadi.

questions.prompt: Where do they sit after shopping? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “After shopping … sit in the park” — bog‘da.

listening.title: The Swimming Lesson Route
listening.text:
Coach: Our lesson is on Tuesday at four. Come to the side entrance.
Parent: Do we go into the changing room first?
Coach: Yes. Walk across the hall, then go into the room on the left. Wait there until four.
Parent: And after the lesson?
Coach: Meet your child outside the changing room. The lesson ends at five.
Parent: Good. My son packs his goggles before school. He is ready hours before the water is!

questions.prompt: On which day is the lesson? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “On Tuesday at four” — seshanba.

questions.prompt: What time does it end? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The lesson ends at five” — beshda.

questions.prompt: Where should parents meet children afterwards? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Outside the changing room” — kiyinish xonasining tashqarisida.

speaking.prompt: 60–75 soniyada bozorga borish yo‘lingiz va jadvalingizni ayting: harakat, boshlanish va keyingi ish.
success: To/into/out of/across dan uchtasi ishlatiladi.
On va at vaqtga mos.
Before/after/until dan ikkitasi ma’noga mos.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda birinchi marta suzish darsiga keladigan oilaga yo‘l va vaqtni tushuntiring.
writing.model: The swimming lesson is on Tuesday at four in the afternoon. Come to the side entrance before the lesson. Walk across the hall and go into the changing room on the left. Children wait there until four. The coach meets them at the door. Parents wait in the cafe during the lesson. After swimming, meet your child outside the changing room. The lesson ends at five. Bring a towel and goggles. Put dry clothes in a separate bag. A warm jumper is useful after an hour in the pool.
success: 80–100 so‘z bor.
Yo‘lning uch bosqichi aniq.
On/at va before/after/until bilan vaqt izchil.

teacherNote: Oldindan: stall — rasta, entrance — kirish, goggles — suzish ko‘zoynagi. Reading yo‘lini strelkalar bilan chizing; listeningni ikki marta o‘qib vaqt–joyni yozdiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga yo‘l sxemasi; ilg‘orga teskari yo‘lni izohlash. Scaffold: during the lesson modelda tayyor birikma; ertaga tizimli ko‘riladi.

objective: From…to, during/for va ravishlar yordamida ishning qayerda, qanday, qachon bajarilishini aytaman.

reading.title: The Practice Room Agreement
reading.text: Our music group uses the community room from six to seven on Fridays. We practise there quietly for the first ten minutes. During the session, our leader listens carefully and gives advice. Sami plays the drums well, but he sometimes plays too loudly. We work hard on the final song. After practice, we carry the chairs outside carefully. The neighbours wave from their windows. Our quiet ending is their favourite part of the concert.

questions.prompt: When does the group use the room on Fridays? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “From six to seven on Fridays” — oltidan yettigacha.

questions.prompt: For how long do they practise quietly at first? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “For the first ten minutes” — dastlabki o‘n daqiqa.

questions.prompt: Who plays the drums well? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Sami plays the drums well” — Sami.

listening.title: The Table Tennis Schedule
listening.text:
Coach: We train here from five to six on Mondays.
New player: How long do we warm up?
Coach: For ten minutes. Walk slowly at first, then move quickly between the markers.
New player: Do we talk during matches?
Coach: Not during a point. Listen carefully between games. Your partner plays well, so watch her feet.
New player: I work hard, but I don't move fast yet.
Coach: That's fine. Good practice matters more than noisy shoes.

questions.prompt: When is training on Mondays? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “From five to six on Mondays” — beshdan oltigacha.

questions.prompt: How long is the warm-up? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “For ten minutes” — o‘n daqiqa.

questions.prompt: What should the new player watch? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Watch her feet” — sherikning oyoq harakatlari.

speaking.prompt: Bir daqiqada musiqa yoki sport mashqi jadvalini ayting: vaqt oralig‘i, davomiylik, joy va qanday bajarish.
success: From…to va for ma’nosi farqlangan.
During dan keyin voqea nomi aytiladi.
Well/hard/fast dan biri va ikkita -ly ravishi bor.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda yangi musiqa a’zosi uchun mashq tartibini yozing.
writing.model: We practise in the community room from six to seven on Fridays. We play quietly for the first ten minutes. During this time, our leader listens carefully to each instrument. Sami plays the drums well, and Lola sings clearly. We work hard on one song before the break. After the break, we play the whole song together. Put your instrument in its case carefully after practice. Carry the chairs outside slowly at seven. The neighbours are friendly, and we respect their quiet evening. Our group makes music, not a thunderstorm.
success: 80–100 so‘z yozilgan.
Vaqt oralig‘i va davomiylik aniq.
Ravishlar harakatni to‘g‘ri tavsiflaydi; hard va hardly almashtirilmagan.

teacherNote: Oldindan: drum — baraban, warm up — badan qizdirmoq, marker — belgi. Readingda vaqt ifodalarini ajrating; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib tartibni tiklang. Sekin o‘quvchiga during + voqea / for + muddat qolipi; ilg‘orga hard/hardly ma’no farqini tarjimasiz misol bilan ko‘rsatish. Matters more than iborasi mazmun uchun, qiyoslash qoidasi hali talab qilinmaydi.

objective: 8-haftadagi savol, joy, harakat, vaqt va ravishlarni bir vaziyatda mustaqil birlashtiraman.

reading.title: The Community Treasure Walk
reading.text: Our treasure walk starts at the library on Sunday at ten. Teams walk across the square and into the park. Who writes the clues? Our librarian writes them. How long does the walk take? About forty minutes. Each team follows the map carefully. The last clue is under a bench between two trees. The treasure is a box of bookmarks. Nobody becomes rich, but everyone leaves with a good reason to read.

questions.prompt: Who writes the clues? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “Our librarian writes them” — kutubxonachi.

questions.prompt: How long does the walk take? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “About forty minutes” — taxminan qirq daqiqa.

questions.prompt: What is the treasure? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The treasure is a box of bookmarks” — xatcho‘plar qutisi.

listening.title: The Museum Volunteer Briefing
listening.text:
Coordinator: Which entrance do visitors use, the front or the side?
Volunteer: The front entrance. Who meets them?
Coordinator: I do. You check tickets at the desk from ten to twelve.
Volunteer: Where do I put their bags?
Coordinator: In the cupboard behind you. Speak clearly and show each visitor the map.
Volunteer: How long is the tour?

questions.prompt: Which entrance do visitors use? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “The front entrance” — oldingi kirish.

questions.prompt: When does the volunteer check tickets? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “From ten to twelve” — o‘ndan o‘n ikkigacha.

questions.prompt: Where should bags go? (Qisqa javobni inglizcha yozing.)
questions.explanation: “In the cupboard behind you” — ko‘ngilli orqasidagi shkaf.

speaking.prompt: 75 soniyada xazina sayrini tushuntiring; sherik vaqt, yo‘l va mas’ul kishi haqida uch savol bersin.
success: Ega va to‘ldiruvchi savoli farqlanadi.
Ikki harakat yoki joy predlogi to‘g‘ri.
Aniq vaqt, davomiylik va bitta ravish bor.

writing.prompt: 80–100 so‘zda yangi jamoa uchun xazina sayri yo‘riqnomasini yozing.
writing.model: Our treasure walk starts at the library on Sunday at ten. Who writes the clues? Our librarian writes them. Walk across the square and go into the park. Read each clue carefully before you move. How long does the walk take? About forty minutes. Stay with your team during the walk. The final clue is under a bench between two trees. Open the small box beside it. There are bookmarks inside for every team member. The treasure is simple, but the walk gives us time together and a new story.

Yo‘l, vaqt va yakuniy joy izchil.
Ikki savol-javob va ravishli ko‘rsatma to‘g‘ri.

teacherNote: Oldindan: clue — topishmoq belgisi, bookmark — xatcho‘p, exhibit — eksponat. 6-kun reading bo‘yicha yo‘lni chizing; listeningni ikki bor o‘qib vazifa kartasini to‘ldiring. Sekin o‘quvchiga savol so‘zlari banki; ilg‘orga boshqa jamoa uchun yangi yo‘l. 1–48 yakunini ichki amaliy ko‘nikma sifatida baholang; B2 sertifikati yoki standart imtihon bali deb atamang.
